newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee belt to see near normal temps - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee belt to see near normal temps - WSC.

text.p: Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected for Brazil's coffee belt today, with temperatures near to below normal, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Tuesday.

Widespread rains of 1-2 inches were reported in Northern Parana and Sao Paulo today. Scattered light to moderate showers were reported in other areas of the coffee belt. Temperatures this morning ranged from the upper 40s to the 50's F (8-15 C) throughout.

Variable clouds are expected for tomorrow with the chance of a few showers. Fair to partly cloudy skies with cooler conditions developing are in the forecast for Thursday and Friday. According to WSC, lows could fall into the 40's to low 50's F (5-12 C).
An intensifying storm system along the south coast of Brazil could drive cooler air up into the coffee belt later this week and over the weekend.
However, the airmass is not expected to cause any damage, WSC said. ((New York Commodity Desk, 212 859-1640))
